mancus

declension

In this lexicon

  • maimed

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Merc. 630: claudus caecus mūtus mancus dēbilis; Cic. Rab. Perd. 21: mancus et membrīs omnibus captus ac dēbilis (Lewis & Short)
